text:
ajay: quick sync idea 1 priming frame right after TLS but before HTTP/gRPC preface. send small payload (client-id, session-id, model, warmup-hash, idempotency-token) to avoid extra RTT for warmups and to allow resume matching.

maria: how does this differ from resume-token header we already have?

ajay: resume-token is sent later in normal flow. priming is preface-level, 1-2KB max, so we can kick off warmups before HTTP headers.

kevin: latency win is clear. risk: middleboxes/proxies expecting immediate HTTP/2 preface might drop bytes. did you test with frontdoor?

ajay: lab tests: our frontdoor accepts TLS-only passthrough. found issues with some gRPC-web proxies that choke on preface bytes. plan: gate priming by ALPN or discovery flag. fallback to header flow if ALPN absent.

sophia: billing/policy question: priming may cause backend work. do we bill for priming?

ajay: proposal: priming itself free. billing begins when request is accepted and backend bound. priming reserves tiny resources (kv slots/memory); enforce soft quotas and surface in console.

maria: need lease window for resume. unlimited window grows state. recommend ephemeral lease + LRU eviction.

kevin: implement as in-memory priming lease for 30s default, admin-configurable up to 5m for Dedicated. emit metric edge.priming.leases_evicted.

ajay: agree. default 30s, per-tenant override. will add metric and admin UI flag.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: add ALPN gate, server feature-flag priming-optin, priming lease metrics, tests for gRPC-web behavior.

sophia: side-effects concern: if client resumes and retries a request that already caused external effects, we must avoid duplicates.

maria: require action-id or mark idempotent if using priming+resume. disable priming by default for high-safety routes.

kevin: encoding question: binary preface vs headers. headers simpler but cost extra RTT. binary efficient but needs spec and ALPN token.

ajay: prototype: tiny binary envelope: 1-byte version, varint length, JSON payload. example: `0x01 <len> {"client":"mobile-1","sid":"...","token":"..."}`. propose ALPN token 'ri-priming/1'.

maria: +1 on versioning and fallback doc. client falls back to resume header if ALPN not negotiated.

sophia: expose priming capability in model catalog as fast-path-enabled flag and per-customer toggle for Dedicated.

ajay: plan: RFC with spec, lease semantics, billing rules, telemetry, and trace/span names. posting tomorrow. thanks :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: noted 1 checklist added to release tasks.
__notes: single-string slack thread. discusses pre-handshake priming frame, ALPN gating, lease lifetime, billing semantics, idempotency requirements, and observability. includes inline code-style example and deploy checklist from ops-bot.
